title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore free social spaces and activities at Bryn Mawr College, from historic reading rooms and meditative labyrinths to seasonal traditions and modern science atriums.

cards.title: Walk the Labyrinth
cards.subtitle: A meditative turf path gifted by McBride Scholars
cards.notes: Walk this seven-ring turf path for quiet reflection. It is located behind the Rhodes South residence hall and is open to the public from sunrise to sunset.
cards.short_summary: A permanent outdoor turf labyrinth designed for meditation and contemplation on the south side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The labyrinth is part of the campus inventory of gardens and is accessible to the public for recreational walks and meditation.
cards.source_title: Revisiting the Eternal Labyrinth - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset; located near Rhoads Hall.

cards.title: Study in the Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Historic reading room in the Old Library
cards.notes: Visit this iconic Gothic Revival space for quiet study or public lectures. It features high timber ceilings and leaded glass windows.
cards.short_summary: A grand, historic reading room in the Old Library used for quiet study, performances, and major college traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Hall is primarily a space for performances, readings, lectures, and public gatherings, and serves as a central reading room.
cards.source_title: History of Old Library - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to the campus community and visitors during building hours; check for event closures.

cards.title: Sled at Rhoads Beach
cards.subtitle: A rolling grassy slope behind Rhoads Hall
cards.notes: Join students on this popular hill for sunbathing in the spring or sledding during winter snows. It offers a wide, open view of the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A signature campus lawn known as 'The Beach,' popular for outdoor relaxation and seasonal sledding.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhoads Beach is the rolling, grassy area on top of which Rhoads sits, used for activities like sledding and sunbathing.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor lawn area located behind Rhoads Hall.

cards.title: Relax by the Cloisters Fountain
cards.subtitle: Secluded courtyard in the Old Library
cards.notes: Sit on the grass in this enclosed courtyard to enjoy the central fountain. It is the site of the annual Lantern Night tradition.
cards.short_summary: An open-air courtyard within the Old Library featuring a central fountain and braid-patterned pathways.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cloisters is an open, outdoor courtyard in the center of Old Library where audience members can sit on the grass.
cards.source_title: Alternative Outdoor Performance Spaces - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the Old Library building; open to the public during building hours.

cards.title: Visit the Park Science Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern glass-walled social hub
cards.notes: Gather in this bright, multi-story atrium for group work or a coffee break. It serves as the main entrance to the renovated Park Science Center.
cards.short_summary: A modern, glass-walled atrium in the Park Science Center designed for student collaboration and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park renovation dramatically opened up the building with the Johanna Alderfer Harris '51 Atrium for student study and social space.
cards.source_title: Renovation Revitalizes Park Science Center - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Located at 900 New Gulph Road; open during academic building hours.

cards.title: Browse the 1912 Gallery
cards.subtitle: Exhibition space in Canaday Library
cards.notes: View rotating exhibits of rare books and artifacts from the college's Special Collections. The gallery is open to the public on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated exhibition space within Canaday Library showcasing the college's rare book and archival collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1912 Gallery functions as an exhibition and learning space open to TriCo community members and public visitors.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm; located on the first floor of Canaday Library.

cards.title: Lounge on Carpenter Roof
cards.subtitle: Elevated lawn behind the Old Library
cards.notes: Enjoy the sun on this grassy rooftop lawn. It features a concrete landing that often serves as a stage for outdoor student performances.
cards.short_summary: A unique green roof on Carpenter Library that provides an elevated lawn for relaxation and small events.
cards.evidence_claim: Carpenter Roof is the lawn that is the roof of Carpenter Library, located behind Old Library; it is a sunny, outdoor space.
cards.source_title: Alternative Outdoor Performance Spaces - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space located behind the Old Library building.

cards.title: Hang in Senior Row Hammocks
cards.subtitle: Shaded path along Merion Green
cards.notes: Find a spot in one of the hammocks along this historic path. While the row is a senior tradition, the hammocks are a favorite for all to relax.
cards.short_summary: A scenic, tree-lined walkway along Merion Green equipped with hammocks for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can do homework in a hammock on Senior Row, a popular spot for relaxing on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor path along Merion Green; hammocks are available seasonally.

cards.title: Hike Morris Woods
cards.subtitle: Campus woodland with nature trails
cards.notes: Explore the trails through this 18-acre woodland on the edge of campus. It is a quiet spot for nature walks and environmental study.
cards.short_summary: A preserved woodland area on the Bryn Mawr campus featuring trails for hiking and mindfulness breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Morris Woods is used for hikes and mindfulness breaks, especially during events like Earth Week.
cards.source_title: Earth Week: SLG Morris Woods Hike - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; trails are accessible from the north side of campus near the athletic fields.

cards.title: Sit at the Moon Bench
cards.subtitle: A crescent-shaped stone bench on Merion Green
cards.notes: Visit this stone bench for a view across Merion Green. It is a central meeting spot for students and a fixture of campus lore.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive crescent-shaped stone bench located on Merion Green, serving as a social landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Moon Bench is a recognized outdoor location on Merion Green used for seating and community gatherings.
cards.source_title: Updated Campus Meeting and Event Space Information - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors on Merion Green; open to the public 24/7.
